behavior.production_full_snapshot_fallback: only for legacy injected clients without additive IExcelRangeReadClient; packaged production OfficeHost implements bounded range reads
behavior.native_direct_edit_tracking: Workbook.SheetChange COM event advances the per-session revision for paged reads; direct user/external-link cell edits participate in the content token.
behavior.native_recalculation_tracking: Workbook.SheetCalculate COM event advances the per-session revision after worksheet recalculation so paged value reads cannot silently mix recalculated generations.
behavior.workbook_rebind_tracking: If the same logical session is rebound to a replacement workbook COM identity, old event sinks are detached and tracking generation changes so prior continuation tokens become stale.
behavior.content_tracking_fail_closed: Multi-page reads return content_tracking_unavailable if Excel events are disabled or required Workbook.SheetChange/SheetCalculate event sinks cannot attach.
behavior.already_unsaved_edit_regression: The E2 direct-edit stale-content case starts page 1 with Saved=false and then mutates another cell; invalidation depends on the content revision, not a Saved transition.
behavior.already_unsaved_recalculate_regression: The E2 recalculation stale-content case starts page 1 with Saved=false and recalculates before continuation; the old token must be rejected.
behavior.continuation_contract_binding: contentVersion is bound to normalized requested range, canonical normalized fields and page size; cursor/version replay with a drifted contract is rejected stale_content/no-effect.
behavior.sheet_identity_continuation: A continuation against a renamed/deleted worksheet returns stale_content/no-effect; native post-page validation re-reads the actual worksheet name so a rename racing the page invalidates the response.

not_claimed.native_excel_e3: AWAITING_ENVIRONMENT / NOT_RUN; E2 covers direct edit/recalculation/rebind/continuation-contract/sheet-rename semantics, but real Excel event delivery and packaged production behavior still require RC-06/07.
